NgoFebhuwari wonke, izinkulungwane zabafundi ziyafika emadolobheni angaziwa zinencwadi yokwamukelwa kodwa zingenandawo yokulala. Uhlu lwezindlu lwalusakazeke emabhodini ezaziso, emaqenjini e-WhatsApp nasezizindeni zezikhangiso ngaphandle kokuqinisekiswa, ukuhlolwa noma ukunxephezelwa.

Sakhe i-RentEase ukuze lonke leli nqubo lifike ku-inthanethi: abanikazi bezindlu abaqinisekisiwe, izithombe eziqotho, amanani abonakalayo, izicelo zedijithali ezinamadokhumenti asekelayo, kanye nerekhodi eliphelele lenkokhelo ngayinye nesicelo sokulungiswa.
